description: P6 evaluation gold set — 30 hand-labeled (claim, evidence) adjudication cases for AAA. Each `reference_verdict` is the author's careful human judgment (supports | contradicts | irrelevant), used to (a) measure the cross-check adjudicator's link-precision on a small illustrative sample and (b) ablate the LLM adjudicator against a deterministic keyword baseline (docs/EVALUATION.md, docs/SYSTEM_DESIGN.md §10). NOT a greenwashing gold set — it grades whether an evidence LINK is correct, never whether a company is greenwashing.
provenance: Claim + evidence texts are copied verbatim from graph_output/crosscheck/aaa_claim_assessments.json. `case_type=real` pairs were actually adjudicated in the production run (P4); `case_type=constructed` pairs pair a real claim with a real but topically-unrelated evidence node to test the 'irrelevant' verdict (production writes no edge for irrelevant, so these are otherwise unobservable).
label_policy: Reference labels reflect a strict-independence reading: an evidence item must speak to the SAME thing the claim asserts. Several `case_type=real` items labeled `irrelevant` are ones where the production LLM returned `contradicts`/`supports` but a human considers the link a temporal mismatch or a metric that does not actually bear on the claim — these are deliberately included to expose failure modes (§12).
